text:
Izzy (People Ops): Heads-up: publishing the Annual Policy Update pack tomorrow AM. It includes revised Acceptable Use, Data Handling, and the new Manager Escalation flow for missed compliance acks. Please review and flag urgent concerns by EOD today: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/annual-update-2026 :eyes:

Marco (Compliance): Quick confirm: will employees have to re-ack all three policies or only those changed? Need to track per-policy acks for audit.

Izzy (People Ops): Only changed policies require re-ack. We'll tag each ack by policy_id and policy_version and export per-policy ack lists. Managers will get a weekly digest of missing acks for their teams.

Tara (People Ops): OpsAdmin-bot, can you schedule the first missing-ack digest for Mon morning?

OpsAdmin-bot: Scheduled: "weekly-missing-acks" digest to managers on Mondays 08:00 UTC, first run 2026-06-08. Includes policy_id, employee_id, manager_id, days_missing. :white_check_mark:

Marco (Compliance): For escalation flow: after 14 days missing, manager gets a 1:1 nudge; after 30 days, People Ops flags for HR follow-up. Please include appeal instructions for employees on leave.

Izzy (People Ops): Agreed. Draft escalation timeline in the pack: 7 days: initial reminder; 14 days: manager nudge; 30 days: HR outreach; 60 days: compliance review. Will include leave/LOA exemptions.

Tara (People Ops): Can translations prepare EN->FR/DE/ES? We'll ship EN + EMEA languages simultaneously. Please note variable placeholders like {policy_name} and keep them intact.

translations: We can deliver FR/DE/ES in 3 business days after text freeze; will mark placeholders.

Marco (Compliance): For audit exports, please include fields: policy_id, policy_version, employee_id, ack_ts, manager_id, employee_status (active/on_leave/terminated). Also keep retention metadata.

Izzy (People Ops): Noted. Example export command will be added to the playbook and the manager guide. I'll post the export SQL before publish.

Tara (People Ops): Final note: we'll require re-ack within 21 days for managers and 30 days for ICs. People Ops will run the weekly export and surface exceptions. Publishing tomorrow; I'll ping this thread when live. Thanks everyone! :tada:
